Branch delay slot: simulator executes delay slot instruction, hardware flushes it

Simulator: fetches from branch target on next cycle; delay slot instruction (already in IF→ID) proceeds through pipeline normally.
Hardware: p_flush zeroes IF→ID instruction register on J/JAL/JR/BZ/BHLEQ taken, AND hazard unit stalls IF for 2 cycles (bz_stall_counter "01").

Current test programs always place NOP in delay slot, so no functional difference. HW checkpoint notes "BZ/BHLEQ stall may be unnecessary (flush+bubble sufficient)" — may change in future phases. Reassess after HW audit.
